source_quote:
**[P1] Do not load `num_scheduled_tokens_ptr` on the precomputed path.**
> `run_fused_postprocess_align()` passes `None` for both `num_scheduled_tokens_ptr` and `num_draft_tokens_ptr` when `PRECOMPUTED_NEW_COMPUTED=True`, but line 80 performs `tl.load(num_scheduled_tokens_ptr + req_idx)` unconditionally before this branch. This can fail during Triton specialization/compilation by doing pointer arithmetic and a load through `None`; relying on dead-code elimination is unsafe. Move the `num_scheduled`, `num_computed`, and `num_draft` loads entirely into the `else` branch, matching upstream.

rule.description: 当某个分支路径会以 `None` 传入某些指针参数（如 `num_scheduled_tokens_ptr`）时，对这些指针的 `tl.load`/指针运算必须放在该参数确实有效的分支内，不得在分支前无条件执行并依赖编译器死代码消除；否则会在 Triton 特化/编译阶段触发指针算术错误。
checkpoints: 检查是否存在"某分支传入 None 指针"的约定（如 `PRECOMPUTED_NEW_COMPUTED=True` 时 `num_scheduled_tokens_ptr=None`）
检查对这些指针的 `tl.load(ptr + offset)` 是否在分支之前无条件执行
不得依赖"分支条件恒假 → 死代码消除"来掩盖 None 指针加载
将仅在特定分支使用的指针加载完整移入该分支

antipattern.code:
num_accepted = tl.load(num_accepted_tokens_ptr + req_idx)
    src_block_idx = tl.load(mamba_state_idx_ptr + req_idx)
    # 无条件加载 — PRECOMPUTED 路径传入 None，此处 tl.load(None + req_idx) 会在
    # Triton 特化/编译阶段失败，不能依赖死代码消除
    num_scheduled = tl.load(num_scheduled_tokens_ptr + req_idx)

    if PRECOMPUTED_NEW_COMPUTED:
        new_num_computed = tl.load(num_computed_tokens_ptr + req_idx)
    else:
        num_computed = tl.load(num_computed_tokens_ptr + req_idx)
        num_draft = tl.load(num_draft_tokens_ptr + req_idx)
        num_tokens_running_state = num_computed + num_scheduled - num_draft
        new_num_computed = num_tokens_running_state + num_accepted - 1

    aligned_new_computed = (new_num_computed // block_size) * block_size
    needs_copy = aligned_new_computed >= num_tokens_running_state

pattern.code:
num_accepted = tl.load(num_accepted_tokens_ptr + req_idx)
    src_block_idx = tl.load(mamba_state_idx_ptr + req_idx)
    # num_scheduled/num_draft 的加载已移入 else 分支，
    # PRECOMPUTED 路径不再触碰 None 指针

    if PRECOMPUTED_NEW_COMPUTED:
        # num_scheduled/num_draft are unused on this path and are passed as
        # None, so they must not be loaded here.
        new_num_computed = tl.load(num_computed_tokens_ptr + req_idx)
        num_tokens_running_state = new_num_computed - num_accepted + 1
    else:
        num_scheduled = tl.load(num_scheduled_tokens_ptr + req_idx)
        num_computed = tl.load(num_computed_tokens_ptr + req_idx)
        num_draft = tl.load(num_draft_tokens_ptr + req_idx)
        num_tokens_running_state = num_computed + num_scheduled - num_draft
        new_num_computed = num_tokens_running_state + num_accepted - 1

    aligned_new_computed = (new_num_computed // block_size) * block_size
    needs_copy = aligned_new_computed >= num_tokens_running_state
